LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE WORD CLASSES: PRONOUNS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which words replace names of people or things in sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify personal and possessive pronouns used as subjects and objects for communication,
2. use personal and possessive pronouns as subject and object correctly for self- expression,
3. adopt the use of personal and possessive pronouns in communication. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns.
2. Explain Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: discuss pictures on the theme using personal and possessive pronouns collaboratively,
4. Show that you can: identify personal and possessive pronouns used as subjects and objects for communication,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use Word classes: Pronouns. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Which words replace names of people or things in sentences?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss pictures on the theme using personal and possessive pronouns collaboratively,
2. Make sentences using the vocabulary words such as wiper, bridge, head lights, signal, fog lights, and use personal and possessive pronouns,
